children: Overview
US asset manager's Q3 revenue rose 8% yr/yr, slightly beating analyst expectations
Q3 EPS increased to $1.50 from $1.34 a year earlier
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current quarter or full year in the press release
Result Drivers
EQUITY ASSET GROWTH - Co said higher average equity assets and record net equity sales, including in MDT quantitative investment solutions, drove revenue growth
ALTERNATIVE STRATEGIES DEMAND - Co said continued demand for alternative/private markets strategies, including MDT Market Neutral offerings, contributed to record assets
FCP ACQUISITION IMPACT - Q2 acquisition of FCP Fund Manager, L.P. contributed to revenue growth and increased compensation and related expenses
